test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.**

The only one ______ shattered their monotony by his visits was Krishna.
solution:
The correct answer is **"whoever."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is talking about someone who was able to break the monotony through their visits, and the correct pronoun to use in this context is **"who."**
 
• **"Who ever"** is the correct form, as it is used to refer to any person who fits the description.
 
 
• **Example**: *The best athlete doesn't always win, but then **whoever**__ said sport was fair?*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The only one __**whoever**__ shattered their monotony by his visits was Krishna.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The use of **"whom" (Option 1)** and** "which" (Option 4) **would be incorrect, as they are used to refer to objects or people being acted upon, rather than the subject of the sentence.
 
• **"Whatever" (Option 2)** is also incorrect, as it is used to refer to things or situations, rather than people.
